description: Golden utterances for parse_request's explicit-vs-inferred group classification (Phase 3.2 / Phase 8.2 of the fix-bugs follow-up plan). Entity GROUP MEMBERSHIP is no longer LLM-scored -- group_tables_into_entities deterministically assigns every discovered table before the LLM is ever called, so a table can no longer be dropped or invented the way the pre-Phase-3 18-type enum allowed. What remains LLM-scored is explicit_groups: which of the deterministic groups (from harness.py's shared _REQUEST_PARSING_SCHEMA fixture) the user's text specifically named, vs. the rest, included by design for completeness. Score = exact set match on explicit_groups, filtered to real deterministic keys exactly as parse_request.py itself filters (`g in deterministic_groups`).
